definitions.explanation: Unpolished rice with the bran layer intact, more nutritious than white rice but with a chewier texture and nuttier flavor.

notes:
USAGE:
{玄米|げんまい} is rice that has only had its husk removed, retaining the bran (⟦{糠|ぬか}→糠：noentry⟧) and germ. It requires longer cooking time and more water than white rice.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {玄米|げんまい}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (cooked brown rice)
- {玄米|げんまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧ (cook brown rice)
- {玄米|げんまい}⟦{食|しょく}→食：noentry⟧ (brown rice diet)
